checklistBuilder._about: How a new inspection's checklist is generated from the wizard selections (mirrors buildGroups() in the prototype). Numbered room sections are 'Bathroom 1..n' etc.; their data comes from the base section name.

Texas.heading: Texas TREC Inspection (REI 7-6)
sections: Texas — III. Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning Systems

checklistBuilder._notes: '?' = included when selected in wizard step 3 rooms; '×n' = repeated per count. Admin-added custom sections are appended to the end of their group (Exterior, Interior, Utility, Testing).
checklistBuilder._formNotes: Sections with 'form' (texas | fourPoint) are client-supplied state/insurance forms: ignore checklist depth (always show 'items'), no Overall condition row, badge = formLabels[form]. 'photosOnly' sections have no items: opening one goes straight to the photo screen, whose primary button is 'Save & continue to summary' (or '… to report' when the layout has no Summary). Layouts without a Summary entry (4 Point) hide 'Review summary'.
